offering_description.value: Develops, manufactures and sells plasma-derived immune globulin therapies for patients with primary immune deficiency and related immune disorders. It collects plasma through its own US donor centers and sells the finished treatments to specialty pharmacies, distributors and infusion providers.

primary_products.value: intravenous immune globulin; subcutaneous immune globulin

customer_segment.value: B2B: specialty pharmacies, distributors, hospitals and infusion clinics that treat immune-deficient patients

revenue_model.value: product sales: immune globulin therapies sold to pharmacies, distributors and providers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: manufactures immune globulin from collected plasma, sold to pharmacies and distributors; asset operator: owns and runs US plasma collection centers that supply raw plasma for manufacturing

geography_served.value: US national: sells across the United States through specialty channels, manufacturing and plasma collection are US-based

specialization.value: niche specialist: focused on immune globulin therapies for immune deficiency and related disorders

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: specialty distributors that supply pharmacies and infusion providers; direct sales: direct sales to hospitals and infusion clinics treating patients; own locations: company-owned plasma collection centers supplying raw material
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; direct sales; own locations

regulatory_exposure.value: high: needs FDA biologics licensing and plasma establishment approvals to manufacture and sell, plasma collection is also FDA-regulated

notes: Plasma center count and facility footprint may have changed; details are based on my general knowledge.
